notes.title: Let's start the Hello University goods raffle event!
notes.content:
Hello, this is Eugene Games.
Hello University is finally here!
We will start an event where 16 steam board buyers will be drawn and goods will be given to you, so please pay a lot of attention!

Event Link : https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeMr5jr7uWmNh_eDxUzY0fMAgpvsnzicbOAkDNK7KpdIftzSw/viewform

※ This is an event for steam users who purchased Hello University games (Stove buyers will be automatically applied) ※

1. Application period: March 13 to March 26 at 23:59
2. Event Rewards: Morgana Acrylic Stand (8 people), Release Acrylic Stand (8 people) Draw Payment
3. Steam and stove goods events will be held separately, and 16 steam users and 16 stove users will be rewarded
4. Winner announcement date: April 16
5. Rewards Delivery Date: April 17
